title: About
description: A desktop app that safely exports and bulk-updates Nulab Backlog issues and users while caching them locally.
author: r404r

github.note: Please report bugs and requests to Issues in this repository.

docs.note: Opens in your default browser (README for an overview, User Guide for detailed steps).

license.name: MIT License
license.note: See the LICENSE file in the distribution and the repository.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.description: Switches the color scheme. The choice is applied immediately and saved automatically.
theme.systemNote: "Match system" follows the appearance setting of your OS.
theme.titleBarNote: The window frame (title bar) follows the app theme on Windows, and the OS appearance setting on macOS.

language.title: 言語 / Language
language.description: Switches the display language. The choice is applied immediately and saved automatically.
language.systemNote: "Match system" follows the language setting of your OS and browser.
language.limitationNote: In this version, data fetched from Backlog, some messages returned by the app, and Excel output remain in Japanese.

storage.title: Stored Data
storage.description: Where this app stores files on this computer. API keys are stored in the OS keychain, not in the files below.
storage.loadFailed: Could not load the stored data information: {message}
storage.databaseNote: A cache of the issues and users fetched so far. You can delete it; the app can fetch them again.
storage.dbMissing: Not created yet (created after a connection test)
storage.logNote: Attaching this file to a bug report speeds up the investigation.
storage.logDisabledNote: Log output is disabled, so no file is created.
